title: New crypto Sharpe ideas: MAX / lottery effect, idiosyncratic volatility, turn-of-month, DVOL variance-risk-premium timing
registered: 2026-10-18, after Gen83 and before any Gen84 number was computed
data: Binance USD-M pack, 20 coins, daily closes from 5m klines, funding; Deribit BTC/ETH DVOL; to 2026-09-30
costs: perp taker 5 bp per unit turnover, funding charged (v5 convention); CFD version: Gen74 spreads 5/10 bp, swap 3.3 bp/day, CFD coin universe only

tests.M1 MAX effect (Grobys & Junttila 2021; L: every Monday 00:00 UTC rank coins listed >= 60 days by MAX = highest daily return over the past 7 days; long the bottom third, short the top third, equal weight, gross 1 (0.5 / 0.5), held 7 days
tests.M2 MAX on 30-day window: same, MAX over the past 30 days
tests.I1 idiosyncratic volatility (PRIMARY): every Monday rank coins by the std of residuals of a 30-day daily regression on BTC (BTC itself excluded); long lowest third, short highest third, gross 1, 7-day hold
tests.T1 turn-of-month (PRIMARY): long BTC and ETH (0.5 each) from the close of the second-to-last calendar day of the month to the close of the 3rd day of the next month; flat otherwise
tests.V1 DVOL VRP timing overlay (PRIMARY): VRP = BTC DVOL(t-1)/100 minus 30-day realised BTC vol (annualised) at t-1; scale the v5 portfolio by 1.25 when VRP is in its trailing-365-day top tercile, 0.75 in its bottom tercile, 1.0 otherwise (vol-target cap unchanged)

pass: new sleeve: TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5, DEV > 0, corr with C* <= 0.3, AND adding it to v5 (Gen72 P1 construction) raises the 2022-26 Sharpe; for the CFD route the same rule against the Gen83 swap-free book. Overlay V1: raises the v5 Sharpe on TEST and HOLD and on 2022-26 without worsening max DD.
selection: only PRIMARY rows can be promoted; variants are reported
